🦖🔥 ‘GODZILLA MINUS ZERO’ IS HEADING TOWARD $100 MILLION WORLDWIDE!

The film is now on track to surpass the $100M mark globally this coming weekend!

It's also showing impressive staying power domestically, with its second-weekend drop expected to be less than 50%.

Did you expect ‘GODZILLA MINUS ZERO’ to become such a box office success?
